data.body: Reproduced at origin/main e0bfa4e5154 (2026-11-04, macOS, py3.12 venv): running tests/interfaces/facades/test_plan_review_attestation_facades.py and test_verify_completion_facades.py together serially fails test_cli_passed_but_unsigned_is_exit_11_with_byte_identical_stderr and test_cli_llm_error_is_clean_exit_one with a '--- Logging error --- ValueError: I/O operation on closed file' traceback in the captured stderr; test_cli_llm_error_is_clean_exit_one passes alone.
